<?php
function zero_ctrl4($formal = 13) {
    declare(ticks=0);
    switch (func_num_args()) {
        case 0:
            echo "COUNT0|", $formal, "|";
            break;
        default:
            echo "BAD-COUNT|";
    }
    return $formal;
}
$value = zero_ctrl4();
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";

<?php
function extra_ctrl4($formal = 13) {
    $formal = 99;
    declare(ticks=0);
    switch (\func_num_args()) {
        case 1:
            echo "BAD-FORMAL-COUNT|";
            break;
        case 2:
            echo "COUNT2|", $formal, "|";
            break;
        default:
            echo "BAD-COUNT|";
    }
    return $formal;
}
$value = extra_ctrl4(3, 7);
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";
